To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we present a new approach to single image dehazing that is based on a refined image formation modeling and a novel solution to the transmission and shading estimation problem.

a refined image formation can be formulated that accounts for shading in addition to haze, and that a solution can be searched that results in a haze transmission function that is uncorrelated to the surface shading.

(1) we introduce a refined image formation equation that accounts for surface reflection and haze transmission; (2) we show how to estimate the transmission function from a single input image; (3) the new model and estimation algorithm are robust to the haze color; (4) the new method is able to restore haze free images with high visibility and correct scene contrast; and (5) we demonstrate the ability to use the transmission function for additional applications such image refocusing and new view synthesis
